# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified pinned browser assets from the Leaflet 1.9.4 release are bundled for offline rendering. See `LICENSE` for its BSD 2-Clause license.

Sources:

- JavaScript, CSS and images: `https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/`
- License: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/v1.9.4/LICENSE`
- Project: <https://leafletjs.com/>

Only the optional OpenStreetMap tile layer makes external map requests.
